title: Bank a fire overnight
kid_text: Keep the coals small and sleep away from them.
safety: Never make a fire in a closed tent or snow cave.
The smoke has a gas you cannot see or smell.

steps.text: Rake the coals into one pile.
Clear the ground around the fire.
Sleep away from anything that burns.
Do not take the fire into a closed shelter.

mistakes.text: You sleep next to tall flame.
mistakes.fix: Let it fall to coals first.

mistakes.text: Dry grass is still near the coals.
mistakes.fix: Clear the ground before you sleep.
